name: provenflow-vscode
description: ProvenFlow's findings in VS Code: model-checked state machines, resource lifecycles, code quality and verified fixes, from the pflow command-line tool.

provenflow.cliPath.description: Path of the pflow command. Empty: node_modules/.bin/pflow in the workspace folder, then pflow on the PATH.

provenflow.runOnSave.description: Analyse the workspace folder when a file is saved.

provenflow.saveDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last save before analysing.

provenflow.fullAnalysis.description: Also run the installed analysers (Semgrep, Infer, ESBMC/CBMC, Kani) and replay counterexamples on the code. Slower.

provenflow.proposeFixes.description: Propose automatic fixes (pflow extract --fix), each verified by re-running the analysis and the build.

provenflow.offerUnverifiedFixes.description: Also offer fixes that could not be verified, to review before keeping them.
